subject: Complete recovery backup initiated via ordered Base64 chunks
body: The direct binary Git object path was rejected by the connector. Primary is preserving complete recoverability by encoding the sealed 93,253-byte recovery ZIP as 16 ordered Base64 chunks. GitHub will remain backup-only. Completion requires GitHub readback of every chunk, reconstruction to the original bytes, and SHA-256 verification against 711322a911683489a39caf875f5b0b40539ba2c42511cb4ec664bed996321bd4 before a complete backup receipt is issued.
